text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I spot Air Groove and Fine Motion
during lunch
break.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
For goodness's sake... It's one thing to
send things without asking, but I wish
they'd consider the
limited space we
have for storage.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer! Sorry for causing a fuss.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
The things is, various shops with
connections to
Ireland have been
sending me packages...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There are many Irish manufacturers and
grocery stores within Japan that support
Fine Motion. On one occasion, she
received a huge amount of tea
leaves...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
There's soda bread, fig rolls, oat
flapjacks, lamb
meat, and so much more!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hehe, it all looks positively scrumptious!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I know you're happy, but there's so much stuff in our room that I can barely move.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
What do you intend to do with this
stuff? You can't hope to eat it all—and
doing so wouldn't
leave you in great
shape for a race anyhow.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
True... But everyone went to the trouble
of
sending me these gifts.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure they want me to enjoy them.
Not to
mention, I love Irish food, so I
want to try each
and every one.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It'll be fine—I'm an Umamusume! I could
eat all of
this before the day's through if
I put my mind to
it. ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
You're right! The best way to show my

appreciation for their support is to win
my races.
choice_data_list: If it interferes with your race, t...
Let's make sure to eat well!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I'll just do a little
taste-testing and
donate the rest to the
school cafeteria. ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'd be thrilled if everyone had the
opportunity to
try Ireland's delicious
cuisine!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hurray! Now that I have your approval, I
just need
to focus on getting through it
all. ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe. I'm going to fill up on all the
Irish food
I've been missing today! Here I
gooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Fine Motion gobbles up several
large
boxes worth of food!
